thinking:
"每日视界" (Daily Vision/Perspective), a national online news outlet.
Adults who read news daily (commuters, breaks).
Professional, fast, clean, easy to navigate.

        *   Home page (latest headlines).
        *   Category page (e.g., Technology/Business).
        *   Article page (full story).
        *   About page.
Simplified Chinese.

        *   Multiple files (index.html + at least 2 others).
        *   Relative links, same tab.
        *   Internal CSS/JS (no remote fonts/scripts).
        *   Realistic content (no Lorem Ipsum).
        *   Responsive for 1440px and smaller.
        *   No AI mentions.
        *   No external submission for forms.

    *   *Color Palette:* Deep blue, white, light grey (classic news feel).
    *   *Typography:* Sans-serif (standard Chinese system fonts).
    *   *Structure:*
        *   Header: Logo, Navigation (Home, Politics, Economics, Tech, Culture, About).
        *   Main Content: Grid or List layouts.
        *   Footer: Copyright, Links.

    *   *index.html (Home):*
        *   Breaking news ticker.
        *   Featured story (large image + title + summary).
        *   Side column for "Trending" or "Most Read".
        *   Grid of recent news across different categories.

    *   *category.html (Technology - 科技):*
        *   Header indicating "Technology" section.
        *   List of articles with thumbnails, dates, and short excerpts.

    *   *article.html (Full Story):*
        *   Main headline.
        *   Author, date, category.
        *   Featured image.
        *   Long-form text.
        *   Related articles section.

    *   *about.html (About Us):*
        *   Mission statement.
        *   History/Team info.
        *   Contact info (static form).

    *   *Home Page:*
        *   Headlines: "城市基础设施升级计划", "全球贸易趋势分析", "新能源汽车市场增长".
    *   *Tech Category:*
        *   Articles: "量子计算的最新突破", "AI在医疗诊断中的应用", "未来十年半导体产业展望".
    *   *Article Detail:*
        *   Topic: "量子计算的最新突破" (Detailed analysis of coherence time, error correction, etc.).
    *   *About Page:*
        *   "每日视界" is dedicated to providing objective, timely, and deep reporting.

    *   *CSS:* Flexbox/Grid for layout. Header fixed or sticky. Clear contrast.
    *   *HTML:* Semantic tags (`<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<footer>`, `<article>`).

    *   Simplified Chinese? Yes.
    *   No AI mentions? Yes.
    *   No remote resources? Yes.
    *   Relative links? Yes.
    *   Realistic content? Yes.
    *   Desktop (1440px) and responsive? Yes.
